A good meal is here
May 2026 • Couples
The only place where we really ate well in Cat Ba.

The dishes are tasty and delicious.
The service is particularly pleasant, always with a smile and a lot of attention. They even come to ask you if their cocktails are to your liking and, if necessary, they adjust them according to your preferences.

It is a bit more expensive than average, but it is truly worth the trip.

I recommend it without any hesitation.
